thread:
Ava Singh: Heads up — HaloLabs flagged a duplicate invoice situation. They received two invoices for April with the same base id but different totals. missing marketplace pass-through on second invoice. ticket#79210
Tom Becker: can you paste the two invoice IDs?
Ava Singh: inv_20260401_halo_A and inv_20260401_halo_B
Nora Kim: customer says amounts: A = $1,245.67, B = $1,200.00. tax lines differ and marketplace-fee missing on B.
Tom Becker: quick glance at billing-run: dedupe key matched but lineitem hash mismatch so retry path generated a second invoice instead of merging/replacing.
Carlos Mendez: logs: ```WARN 2026-04-01T01:59:59Z billing: invoice-build start acct=halolabs id=acct_772
INFO 2026-04-01T02:00:01Z tax-calc: tax_total=45.67 marketplace_pass=30.00 line_hash=abc123
INFO 2026-04-01T02:00:02Z billing: retry triggered for invoice_key=2026-04-01-acct_772 reason=timeout
INFO 2026-04-01T02:00:03Z tax-calc: tax_total=42.00 marketplace_pass=0.00 line_hash=def456
WARN 2026-04-01T02:00:04Z billing: duplicate invoice created invoice_id=inv_20260401_halo_B original=inv_20260401_halo_A```
Ava Singh: so the retry run recalculated tax and droppped the pass-through. must be nondeterministic calc during retry.
Tom Becker: probable root: marketplace fee is pulled from an external vendor sync that sometimes returns late; initial run had it, retry missed it. dedupe logic currently only checks invoice_key not deep line equality.
Nora Kim: finance ok to credit the difference and reissue a corrected invoice, but need an external-facing note and an internal audit log. keep customer impact minimal.
Carlos Mendez: proposed remediation steps: 1) Issue credit for inv_20260401_halo_B for $1200.00 and void it. 2) Reissue corrected invoice equal to inv_A as replacement. 3) Patch dedupe to compare signature of lineitems (PR: billing/dedupe-linehash). 4) Add vendor sync retry guard before retrying invoice generation.
Ava Singh: I can run the reissue and credit once finance confirms amounts. Nora?
Nora Kim: confirmed. approve credit for $1200.00 and replacement invoice. Please add an audit note: "voided duplicate due to non-deterministic vendor pass-through fetch; credit issued; replacement invoice provided."
BillingBot: Automated: created follow-up task TASK-9945 assigned to @Carlos Mendez for patch and vendor sync guard. Monitoring enabled for acct_772 for 72h.
Tom Becker: I'll add an integration test that stubs vendor sync latency and asserts dedupe doesn't create second invoice.
Ava Singh: I'll draft the customer email and attach the credit note + replacement invoice. tagging @BillingBot to watch for any more same-key duplicates.
BillingBot: watching acct_772 for duplicate invoice events. will alert #finance and #eng-billing if seen.
